newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech files to speed up Ohio competition.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech files to speed up Ohio competition.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Wednesday it has filed paperwork with the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio to try to speed up the process for adopting competition for local telephone service.
Ameritech said it filed a detailed petition with the commission to demonstrate its compliance with the federal Telecommunication Act's 14 point competitive checklist.
The commission has 60 days to act on Ameritech's petition, it said. If the commission acts quickly, Ohio consumers could see full telecommunications competition by early 1997, Ameritech said.
